title: Rising R&B Onyx Léon Duo Impresses fans with a new track, "Better Than Me"
htmlContent:
R&B duo Onyx Léon have achieved that and more with their debut track "Better Than Me ." The track efforts continue to push the artist's main narrative forward. It is rare that a track comes out of nowhere and hits you the very first time you hear it in a world of sensory brilliance. 

Onyx Léon's "Better Than Me" is a modern mid-tempo R&B track with heavy influences of early 2000's RnB with an updated edge that sets the stage for his audience to enjoy. The authenticity in the sound shines to the fullest, with you being able to focus on each aspect of the song and want it to the fullest. In this master class of audio, one listen will never be enough.
